name: Letter Drop
summary: A pink delete pill whose letters hop one by one into a little bin, with a working Undo
about: Letter Drop deletes a chat message in style. The letters wave on hover, lean back when pressed, then hop in arcs into the bin, which gulps after every bite. Hearts pop out, the bin turns into a tick, and an Undo toast gives six seconds to make the letters jump back out with a bouncy landing. Good for messages, notes and comments.
how: Hover to make the letters wave; press Delete under the message.
The pill squeezes and the letters lean back, then hop one at a time into the bin, last letter first.
The bin boings and pops hearts, the message reads This message was deleted and an Undo toast appears.
Press Undo and the letters jump back out and land with a bounce; otherwise the demo resets after 6 seconds.
